title: Cosmic Scarab Ritual
description: A large white line-art scarab beetle with a human face on its thorax is centered against a black background. Swirling colorful energy streams in orange, green, blue, purple, and yellow flow outward from the beetle, with astrological symbols, runes, seven lit candles, and glowing golden circles arranged in a ritual formation below.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal illustration of a large scarab beetle with intricate white line art and a human face on its body, positioned centrally on a black background. Swirling streams of vibrant orange, green, blue, purple, and yellow energy radiate outward like cosmic wings. Below the beetle is a ritual altar with seven lit white candles surrounded by glowing golden circles and runes. Astrological and mystical symbols float throughout the composition in a dark occult style.
